summary: Iteration 10: Verified weekday fee, crew assignment/team_fee, crew job lifecycle, WhatsApp template, obsolete admin work endpoint removal, finance summary and frontend widgets (BookingForm, AdminBookingModal, FinanceDashboard, TeamManager, Admin Bookings crew filter). 15/15 backend pytest cases pass. All key frontend testids render correctly.
action_items: Consider adding a pytest.ini override or module-scoped shared state fixture for tests that mutate cross-class state — current pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` which splits classes across workers and breaks shared module-level lists. Iteration 10 file must be run with `-n 0` (serial); documented at top of the file. If parallel is desired, consolidate the flow into a single class so loadscope keeps it on one worker.
Consider pinning holiday list beyond 2026 — the code only defines NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS_2026. Weekday fee will incorrectly charge on 2027+ holidays.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS_2026 hardcoded and never expanded — future-year national holidays will be treated as regular weekdays. Externalise to DB or extend by year.
list_bookings computes team_fee per crew based on booking total_price — value duplicated in-memory rather than derived from a helper attached to booking. OK but consider centralising.
AdminDashboard.jsx renders booking-assigned-crew-{id} only when assigned_crew.length > 0. Good. work_drive_url anchor is clickable (target=_blank) as required.
CrewDashboard.jsx uses the exact WhatsApp template string per spec: 'Haii kak...✨ Perkenalkan aku dari tim SESI RESEPSI yang akan bertugas di acara kakak☺️🙏'.
test_credentials: Admin: fikabisadimartyansyah@gmail.com / Biyan2026. Temporary TEST_ crew accounts created and cleaned up during tests.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_-prefixed transient bookings, team members, crew accounts and assignments (all cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the new suite with `pytest -n 0 backend/tests/test_iteration10_weekday_finance.py` because module-level lists are shared across classes. Preview URL: https://pink-wedding-studio.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin login placeholder is 'Username atau email admin' with testid `admin-username`. Finance tab testid is `tab-finance`. Booking modal weekday-fee widget only renders when event_date is a Mon–Fri non-holiday.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only note: initial pytest run failed 8/15 because pytest.ini enforces xdist with `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; classes were split across two workers and each worker had its own copy of module-level `created_bookings`. Running with `-n 0` (serial) restores state sharing and 15/15 pass. Backend behavior is correct.
